content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 28.1 (Singapore law + exclusive Singapore courts) is a deviation into walk-away territory and conflicts with § 28.2, which already provides exclusive New York County jurisdiction with only a temporary injunctive relief carve-out. Single surgical replacement changes the governing law to New York and drops the conflicting Singapore forum words; § 28.2 and the § 28.3 escalation process are left untouched.
